items.title: Alvin "Red" Tyler Interview, 1996-06-19
items.q: Uh, so, we had Melvin Lasty on trumpet. Uh, Harold Batista was, uh, saxophone.

ctx.x: And they picked what they needed. Right. You know, saxophones, trumpet, guitar, bass, drums. And, uh, Alan Toussaint was supposed to be a part of it, and he said he would be a part of it. And, last minute, he backed out of it. Uh, so, we had Melvin Lasty on trumpet. Uh, Harold Batista was, uh, saxophone. He played a little piano. Drums, John Boudreau. Uh, bass, Chuck Beatty. Roy Montreal on guitar and myself on saxophone. And we formed a production company, but we had no money.
